reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and, consistent with that, no redline or counterparty comment is proposed — the rendered paragraphs are identical to the originals, which is the expected output for a compliance finding.

The cited text supports the conclusion: § 8(c) uses 'employees' only in an access-restriction covenant and § 8(d) cross-references the separate Non-Competition Agreement solely as a limitation on TrueLink's licence to use Credit Data; neither imposes any non-solicit, no-hire or anti-poaching restraint on Client (the Customer).
Absence of any non-solicit binding the Customer matches the playbook preferred position ('No non-solicit on Customer'), so the fallback narrowing edits are correctly not applied.
The two failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months; general-solicitation carve-out) are artifacts of there being no non-solicit clause to measure and do not indicate a defective proposal.
The reviewer note flagging that the separate Non-Competition Agreement is outside this document and should be diligenced separately is appropriate and does not undermine the in-document finding.
